
---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  group_by(Activity) |>
  mutate(total = sum(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(total >= 50) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = n,
    y = fct_reorder(Activity, total),
    fill = Fatal_clean
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs Non-Fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    x = "Number of Attacks",
    y = "Activity",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
